name: In her head
source: "In Her Head" - a captivating visual novel that offers players a unique glimpse into the daily struggles of the main character with social anxiety. Immerse yourself in her inner world, where anxiety, procrastination, and unease are constant companions. In this visual novel, you will experience several days in her life, with the central challenge being a single task — making a phone call to schedule a haircut. But what is it like when every call feels like a trial? Help her overcome her fears and take this step.
translation: 《In Her Head》——一部引人入胜的视觉小说，让玩家以独特的视角了解主角与社交焦虑症的日常斗争。让自己沉浸在她的内心世界中，焦虑、拖延和不安始终伴随着她。在这部视觉小说中，你将经历她生活中的几天，核心挑战是一个任务——打电话安排理发。但是，当每次通话都感觉像是一次审判时，感觉如何？帮助她克服恐惧并迈出这一步。
